case.value: As the bulls (Cantor Fitzgerald's fresh $80 initiation, Piper Sandler's upgrade) frame it, Tempus AI is the AI-native precision-medicine platform monetizing a growing genomic and multimodal data library across diagnostics and pharma partnerships (e.g., Merck, AstraZeneca), with revenue growth continuing (Q2 2026 +0.7% sequential beat) and a first GAAP-profitable quarter.

depends_on.value: Whether FY2026 revenue actually reaches the guided ~$1.6B and gross margin holds near the ~64% level seen in Q2 2026, while GAAP profitability (achieved for the first time in Q2 2026 at +$5.64M) proves durable rather than a one-quarter blip.

bear_case.value: Short interest is extremely elevated (21.9-27.8% of float depending on source, ~7.3 days to cover), a Spruce Point short report alleged aggressive accounting and overstated AI revenue contribution and triggered a shareholder lawsuit, the stock still trades at a rich EV/sales multiple versus diagnostics peers, and free cash flow remains deeply negative (-$263M TTM).

why_it_fell.value: Down 38.1% from its 52-week high, driven by a multi-month de-rating from December 2025 through March 2026 (down ~24% in Dec, 11% in Feb, 15% in Mar) on valuation concerns (rich EV/sales multiple), record-high short interest (peaked near 30.5% of float per one source), and lingering fallout from a Spruce Point Capital short report alleging aggressive accounting and overstated AI-revenue contribution, which also triggered shareholder litigation — even as the company continued posting revenue growth and new pharma partnerships (Merck, ARK Invest buying).

judgment.prospect_why: The case is an AI-native precision-medicine platform reaching its first GAAP profit, and it is guided rather than story: FY26 revenue consensus $1.60B up 25.6%, EPS improving from -$0.61 to -$0.26 to -$0.02 in FY27, with the guide held at the last print.
judgment.competition_why: Gross margin is stable at 63-65% and the MRD acquisition gives it a shot at a duopoly with Natera, but Natera is the stronger franchise and both Guardant at 18.9x and Natera at 17.2x EV/sales anchor the group, so this is stable rather than widening.
judgment.macro_fit_why: Still-unprofitable growth healthcare burning $263.2M carries real duration into a rising-real-yield regime, though far less than IONQ because breakeven is one year out rather than several; healthcare is not among the leading sectors.
judgment.narrative_why: It sits inside the AI theme with genuine revenue underneath it, which the doctrine treats better than a pure narrative, but the theme is stable rather than accelerating and the name carries a Spruce Point short report and 22% to 28% short interest against it.
